integrity: The depth formula is proved from an exact round-by-round clipped-distance characterization; a standalone exhaustive checker independently replays the refinement partitions over 11,385 finite instances.
scientific limitations: Only ordinary one-dimensional color refinement from the uniform coloring is treated.
Every branch-to-branch path is required to have length at least two, so the graph is a simple subdivision of K_{2,d}.
The literature search was targeted rather than exhaustive; an unindexed family-specific occurrence remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact color-refinement depth of generalized theta graphs
